A [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sanyassan''' once entered a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], where a [[StarSpeeder 3000]] transport from the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company had landed. With the help of a fellow [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]], the criminal assaulted the crewmen of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].<ref name="EndorModdell" />
